name: Dick Van Dyke
summary: An entertainer known for The Dick Van Dyke Show and Mary Poppins, he has endorsed Democratic candidates (Bernie Sanders in 2016 and 2020, Kamala Harris in 2024) and voiced fear of Donald Trump. The sources name no policy position that the test statements address, so his record here is empty.

sources.title: Dick Van Dyke has a morbidly funny take on Donald Trump election win
sources.author: The List
sources.usedFor: His 2016 CNN remarks on Trump and war and 2020 video on democracy, quoted
